name: gameplay-birthday-start
origin: The gameplay screen at the round's first frame on the Birthday Party stage set (checkpoint 5, Birthday Party slice): as gameplay-cinema-start (Arcade, Normal, robot 0, through the real menus) but with seed 11, whose round rolls BirthdayPartyStage2 with its four toy hands (seed 42 rolls the handless BirthdayPartyStage3), and Game Settings' stage list picks Birthday Party (restaurantStages, GameSettingsUI.stagesHandle: GameModel.stages = "BirthdayParty"; the click is the centre of its stage bounds in the game-settings dropdown golden). The capture is the first frame without UI_reading, 61 frames after START.
godot_note: Robots are drawn from their original clips (scripts/ui/game_actors.gd); the node diff and the pixel score include them.

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the birthday-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
